items.headline: Why Keysight Shares Are Trading Higher By 3%; Here Are 20 Stocks Moving Premarket
items.summary: KEYS stock rose 3% in pre-market trading due to strong financial results and guidance. Other gainers include TNON, BIVI, ZNB, MSS, CAST, RCON, TGL, OPHC, and GURE. Losers include DAIC, PFSA, TPET, and OSRH with significant declines.
